title: Do not count every 404 as an account denial.
comment:
**Do not count every 404 as an account denial.**

If `DEMO_URL` accepts login but its invoice routes or fixture are missing, three JSON 404 responses make this script print “Verified.” The script has not tested the account boundary in that case. Before counting Cedar’s denials, confirm that the same routes work and that Maple can retrieve `INV-2002`. As a focused check, point the script at a server that returns JSON 404 for the three invoice routes; the non-vulnerable check must exit with an error. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coderabbit-demo/mmani-cr-security/main/scripts/reproduce-invoice.js))

As per path instructions, “Report only supported issues” and “Include the affected path, practical impact, specific fix, and a focused validation step.”    


Also applies to: 23-23
